newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds -Prices steady-slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds -Prices steady-slightly higher.

text.p: Cash millfeed prices were steady to slightly higher, largely in reaction to strong gains in CBOT corn futures Tuesday, millfeed dealers said.

Millfeed buyers were more active than is usual this early in week, partly because of the higher corn futures at the Chicago Board of Trade. Buyers who normally waited until late in the week were shopping Tuesday morning, buying mainly for immediate needs.
Ample supplies of competing feed ingredients such as soymeal, soybean hulls and cottonseed meal were preventing flour mills and brokers from significantly raising millfeed prices, some dealers said.
